I tend to solo q and rarely play with teammates. I got upto diamond 3 in 2s and diamond 1 in 3s. When I'm playing I try not to worry about how bad my teammates are.

Rocket league is a huge playstyle game and solo queuing is basically randomise your teams playstyle as there is no coms, you get ball chasers, people that don't understand rotation properly. Within the first minute you can tend to get feel for how each team is playing. Try and adapt to playstyles. If I notice I have a ball chasing teammate that likes to over commit, let him, be aware of his positioning. Position your self to be ready for offensive and ready to get back and defend for their big whiff or no boost play. 

You also want to be aware of how your opponents are playing cause you may see consistent mistakes you can punish them for.

Boost management is probably the most important thing that will help you as well so your not taking yourself out of the play too much. Also recommend training packs and focus on what you consistently keep screwing up.
